name: MegaMan's buster flash
why: As his buster fires the engine spawns two flashes for MegaMan (objects of the first kind, type 5, his object at their +0x4C), by its spawner of such effects with the number of the one wanted in its own list: BN5's numbers them 0x23 and 0x0D, BN6's 6 and 5, each drawn from its own sprite (the mask 'MegaMan's own sprite'). His presentation.
evidence: the spawner of the first kind's type 5: BN5 0x080B9CAE / BN6 0x080BA6A0 (the first kind's spawner, BN5 0x08003140 / BN6 0x08003320, with r0 5), its number in +4
their sprites: BN5 0x082F261C (named at 0x08032864), BN6 0x082F6444 (named at 0x08031E0C)
